messages:
samir: Hey team, quick design review request for the compact compare UI in the model catalog. Posting Figma + mobile/desktop snaps. Main changes: tighter rows, stacked perf badges, persistent filter chips. Need accessibility review and copy polish before we ship.

maya: Scanning now. Contrast issue: the 'CPU perf' badge in dark theme is low contrast. Recommend switching to semantic tokens (accent-2 on dark) instead of #b3b3b3.

toni: I like denser rows but worried about keyboard nav. Right now the whole row is focusable and Enter toggles the compare checkbox. Do we want that or should only the checkbox be in tab order?

samir: Prototype currently has row focusable for click-to-select. Open to changing—what's the tradeoff?

eli: Accessibility note: if the whole row is focusable we must ensure role="row" and role="gridcell" semantics and set aria-selected on selection. Also add an aria-live region for compare count updates (e.g., "3 models selected"). And the compare dialog needs an aria-label like "Compare 3 models: latency median highlighted".

lindsey: Copy tweak: change "Pin version" to "Pin model version". Badges: prefer "p50 latency" rather than just "Latency" so it's explicit.

maya: Suggest showing p50 prominently and p95 as secondary text in compact mode. Tooltip can include a tiny sparkline/histogram on hover. Also bump badge hit target to at least 40px for mobile.

toni: For keyboard users I still prefer only checkbox tabbable + a single "Compare selected" button in the toolbar that opens the compare modal. Prevents tabbing into each row accidentally.

design-bot: Created ticket D-4532 for follow-ups: https://design.redwood/d/4532/compact-compare 

eli: Ran axe on the frame: found missing aria-expanded on filter groups and collapsed filter chips lack accessible names. Need aria-label on icon-only chips or visible labels. Also flagged insufficient color contrast for badge text on dark.

maya: I'll update color tokens and increase contrast. Also will mock touch states for badges and enlarge spacing in mobile frame.

samir: Thanks. Plan: make checkbox tabbable only, add aria-live for selection count, update copy (pin -> pin model version), adjust badges to show p50/p95, and fix contrast. I'll push updated frames and screenshots to D-4532 by end of day. :thumbsup:
